intro h
let a := (t \ s).choose
have h1 : a ∈ t := by exact Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_set_of_eq.mp (t \ s).choose_spec.2)
have h2 : a ∉ s := by exact (t \ s).choose_spec.1
have h3 : t.erase a = s :=
  by
    rw [Finset.erase_union_right_iff]
    exact ⟨h2, Finset.subset.antisymm (Finset.subset.trans (Finset.subset_union_left _) h) (Finset.subset.refl _)⟩
exact ⟨a, h1, h2, h3⟩
